description:
## Why This Exists

post/sign.rs::sign_article() uses: let sep_len: usize = if body_start >= 4 && ...[body_start-4..body_start] == *b"

" { 2 } else { 1 }. The variable is called 'sep_len' but the value is the length of the second CRLF (not the full separator). If the body_start < 4 branch is taken, sep_len = 1 (LF case). This logic is also duplicated in injection.rs and did_passthrough.rs.

The magic values 2 and 1 are cryptic without comments. Consolidating into a named function would remove duplication and make intent clear.

## Acceptance Criteria

Extract a separator_suffix_len(article_bytes, body_start) -> usize function in post/mod.rs. Use it in sign.rs, injection.rs, and did_passthrough.rs.
title: Rust idiom: sign_article sep_len detection checks body_start >= 4 but sep_len is also used for sep_len=1
